name: kite-tasks
description: Read your Kite tasks and make everyday changes as you: create, update, complete, comment.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to your team's Kite Tasks. Claude can read My Tasks, search, open tasks with their comments, list projects, members and your inbox, and create, update, complete or comment on tasks as you. It can't delete anything. Create a token in Kite: Settings → Claude.

kite_url.title: Kite address
kite_url.description: The address you open Kite at, e.g. https://kite.example.com/task-manager. Copy it from Kite: Settings → Claude.

kite_token.title: Kite token
kite_token.description: A token from Kite: Settings → Claude → Create token. Anyone with it can act as you in Kite.

kite_workspace.title: Workspace (optional)
kite_workspace.description: Workspace slug to use by default when you are in several, e.g. kite-studio.
